propagation_patterns.pattern: Propagation through Telstra (1299) and China Telecom (3223)
Propagation through Level 3 (3356) and Telecom Italia (6762)
Propagation through NTT (2914) and China Telecom (3223)
Multi-hop propagation through various European transit

path_inflation_analysis.notes: Significant path inflation due to insertion of multiple transit ASes (3223, 6762, etc.) between the hijacker and observing peers

geographic_analysis.transit_network_coverage: Global coverage including Asia-Pacific (China Telecom), Europe (Telecom Italia, Colt, PCCW), North America (Level 3, AT&T, Cogent), Australia (Telstra)

impact_assessment.visibility: High - observed by 12 different peer ASNs across multiple continents
impact_assessment.reachability_impact: Significant - traffic for 172.81.129.0/24 redirected to attacker in China
impact_assessment.duration_impact: Extended - anomaly lasted approximately 49 hours (2015-12-04 19:30 to 2015-12-06 21:00)
impact_assessment.mitigation_difficulty: Moderate - requires coordination with multiple Tier 1 networks to filter the hijacked prefix

recommendations: Notify AS 3223 (China Telecom) to filter announcements from AS 203959 for hijacked prefix 172.81.129.0/24
Coordinate with Tier 1 networks (Level 3, Telstra, NTT, Cogent) to implement prefix filters
AS 46664 should implement RPKI ROA for 172.81.128.0/21 to prevent unauthorized more-specific announcements
Monitor for similar hijack attempts from AS 203959, which has history of prefix hijacks
Implement BGP monitoring with real-time alerting for prefix hijack detection
